from typing import List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class CompanyMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics for a single company extracted from one document."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="The stock ticker code of the company")
    period: Optional[str] = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2025-Q1')")
    operating_revenue: Optional[float] = Field(description="Operating Revenue amount")
    operating_cash_flow: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities")
    cash_paid_fixed_assets: Optional[float] = Field(description="Cash Paid for Acquisition of Fixed Assets, Intangibles, and Other Long-Term Assets")
    financial_expenses: Optional[float] = Field(description="Financial Expenses amount")


class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container for all parsed company metrics."""
    companies: List[CompanyMetrics]
